meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 当你要做幻灯片或演示时,Claude会生成一个可点击浏览的交互式演示deck,支持分步显示、热点跳转、分支和演讲者备注;也可以把现有网页转成演示。输出是可运行的deck,不是视频。
howto.when: 当你明确要幻灯片(slideshow)时直接做;当你说要做演示文稿、deck、pitch deck等,或把页面转成演示时,会先确认是否要HyperFrames slideshow。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品发布会的幻灯片,每页备注写清要点。
say.note: 生成带备注的演示deck,可直接运行。

say.text: 把公司主页转成幻灯片,保留原有滚动动效。
say.note: 会先确认,并尽量保留原页面动效。

say.text: 在幻灯片上加一个热点,点击跳到市场分析那页。
say.note: 热点导航会触发对应分支序列。

howto.what_en: Builds a runnable HyperFrames slideshow: clickable deck with slides, reveals, branching, hotspots, speaker notes, presenter mode. Can convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask for a slideshow; for adjacent requests like 'presentation', 'deck', or page-to-deck conversion, Claude asks to confirm before proceeding.

say_en.text: Make a slideshow for our product launch, with speaker notes on each slide.
say_en.note: Creates a runnable deck with presenter notes.

say_en.text: Turn our homepage into an interactive deck, keeping the scroll motion.
say_en.note: Confirms first, then preserves page motion.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on this slide that jumps to the market analysis slide.
